description: This file is a C++ source file implementing components for setting up and managing WebRTC streaming and related features in a virtualized environment, including socket creation, command generation, and dependency injection setup.

classes.name: StreamerSockets
classes.description: Handles creation of socket connections for streaming, including input, frame, and audio sockets, and manages their initialization and configuration.

classes.name: WebRtcServer
classes.description: Manages the WebRTC server setup, including command generation, dependencies, and configuration for streaming WebRTC data.

methods.name: CreateUnixInputServer
methods.description: Creates a local Unix domain socket server at the specified path.

methods.name: LaunchCustomActionServers
methods.description: Launches custom action servers and creates associated commands, setting up socket pairs for communication.
